ad_library.summary: Arcedo Systems runs three live ads on its 'Arcedo Systemss' page - a Telugu PM Surya Ghar subsidy-eligibility ad (23 Sep, fb.me), a Telugu residential ad carrying Suryon Solar Systems branding that points at solar.suryon.in (30 Sep), and an English commercial OPEX ad for factories pointing at a Messenger document (17 Oct). A sibling Facebook page named 'Suryon' runs the same brand's residential Telugu ads with Arcedo's own contact details in the copy (info@arcedo.net, 844 844 8552) - one company, two pages, two brand names. arcedo.net itself is the large-scale-PV EPC site (rooftop, ground-mount, floating, O&M); the ads sell Rs 78,000-subsidy homes and zero-capex factory OPEX.

funnel.destination: fb.me (Telugu subsidy ad), solar.suryon.in (Suryon-branded residential ad), fb.com/messenger_doc/ (commercial OPEX ad)
funnel.meaning: Three live ads, three different destinations - and not one of them is a page on arcedo.net. The residential click lands on a subdomain of a different brand name; the commercial click lands in a Messenger document. No single owned funnel, no shared page to test.

findings: Three live ads (23 Sep, 30 Sep, 17 Oct) with three different destinations: fb.me, solar.suryon.in and a Messenger document. None lands on arcedo.net.

One company, two brands: the Telugu residential ad on the Arcedo page carries Suryon Solar Systems branding and points at solar.suryon.in, while a separate 'Suryon' Facebook page runs the same brand's ads with Arcedo's contact details (info@arcedo.net, 844 844 8552) in the copy.
The commercial OPEX ad - the highest-ticket offer (solar + battery for factories, zero capex) - sends its click to a Messenger document rather than a page that explains the OPEX model.

arcedo.net positions as a large-scale solar EPC (rooftop, ground-mounted, floating solar, O&M, MEP) while the ads sell Rs 78,000-subsidy homes and zero-capex commercial OPEX - the ad-to-site message match is weak in both directions.
The company's empanelment credentials (TGREDCO empanelled supplier and TGNPDCL listed vendor, per the Telangana discom supplier lists) appear nowhere in the live ad copy.
next_steps: Decide whether the residential buyer meets Arcedo or Suryon, then point every residential ad at one owned page on arcedo.net with the subsidy offer, the 25-year performance warranty and the free site visit on it.
Give the OPEX offer a real page

Solar + battery at zero capex for factories is the highest-value offer in the account. A page with the OPEX model, the 50% bill-cut claim and the +91 844 844 8552 contact converts better than a Messenger document.
Put the empanelment in the copy
TGREDCO-empanelled and discom-listed is the trust asset a subsidy buyer looks for - it belongs in the Telugu ad, not only in a supplier PDF.
